Why Secludy

**Make privacy-preserving AI the default**
------------------------------------------

We are building a proprietary generative engine that creates privacy-protected synthetic data for regulated industries like fintech, healthcare, and life sciences. Small team, high ownership, direct work with the founders.

  

### **Machine Learning Engineer**

SF Bay Area, Hybrid

#### **The opportunity**

Secludy is a San Francisco-based, venture-backed startup on a mission to make privacy-preserving AI the industry default and keep individual privacy intact as AI scales. The platform lets organizations use sensitive data through synthetic data generation with provable privacy guarantees.

Fintech, healthcare, and life-sciences customers trust Secludy to protect sensitive data and IP while training AI models.

Accelerate the research loop

* Push performance through simpler architecture, not patches.
* Investigate failures that span infrastructure and math, like out-of-memory errors, race conditions, loss divergence, and gradient explosion.
* Build the harness that shows exactly how metrics change when the model changes.

Productionize the engine

* Orchestrate distributed training and generation across GPU clusters with Kubernetes using minimal, self-healing deployments.
* Own the deployment pipeline.
* Build logging that explains why a generation job failed, not just that it failed.

* Strong PyTorch. You can write a custom training loop from scratch.

* Comfortable with tabular, free-text, or time-series data.

Ready to build the infrastructure for safe enterprise AI

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Do you want to decide whether a generative imaging feature is good enough to ship? Our team evaluates generative image and video features. These features reach a very large number of people on Apple devices. You will build the evaluation systems, human-annotation programs, and automated metrics that turn "this looks better" into measurable, trustworthy quality signals. Those signals guide model development and release decisions.  
  
**Description**  
  
You'll own quality evaluation end to end - from evaluation set design through annotation, scoring, analysis, and the recommendations that shape what engineering and product build next. Your findings determine which models ship.  
  
What you'll do  
  
Build the measurement foundation. Design and maintain golden sets and evaluation sets, analyzing data distributions so results stay representative and known defects stay covered.  
  
Run human evaluation at quality. Write and iterate annotation guidelines and label schemas, build or adapt lightweight labeling tools for image and video review, monitor annotator quality, and resolve disagreements and guideline ambiguity.  
  
Automate the repeatable parts. Develop automated metrics and LLM-as-judge systems, calibrate them against human labels, and track where they diverge.  
  
Make the results decision-ready. Report model-vs-model comparisons with confidence intervals, significance testing, and breakdowns by hotspot, content type, and failure mode - then turn them into root-cause findings and prioritized recommendations.  
  
Set the bar with your partners. Work with ML, engineering, and design to define quality standards, and communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Experience evaluating 3D Gaussian splats or diffusion models, or assessing perceptual quality.  
  
Experience building LLM or VLM judges and validating them against human ratings.  
  
Experience building web-based labeling or review tools.  
  
Ability to run several work-streams in parallel and prioritize them.  
  
Proven cross-functional collaboration and the ability to learn new tools quickly.  
  
Strong written and verbal communication, including explaining statistical tradeoffs to engineers and product partners.  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
MS and a minimum of 5 years relevant industry experience  
  
5+ years of experience in data science, machine learning evaluation, algorithm analysis, or related technical disciplines.  
  
Experience designing and analyzing evaluations and experiments, especially for ML or generative model quality. This includes sampling design, significance testing, and confidence intervals.  
  
Strong Python skills and comfort with SQL, with the ability to build and maintain evaluation pipelines and small tools.  
  
Familiarity with AI-assisted analysis workflows, foundation models, agentic systems, or intelligent automation approaches for technical problem solving.

The base pay range for this role is between $184,700 and $324,800, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We're on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you'll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Are you an engineer early in your career who wants to apply AI and ML to make large systems more reliable and scalable? We're looking for Software Engineers to join the Reliability team at Roblox. In this role you will help evolve the systems that keep Roblox fast, reliable, and efficient, and you will learn alongside senior engineers who build infrastructure at global scale.

You'll work with engineers on our team and in partner teams to build infrastructure that supports Roblox growth. If you like digging into hard technical problems and shipping solutions that hold up in production, we want to hear from you.

At Roblox, our vision is to reach 1 billion daily active users. As part of this team, your work will directly help us scale toward that goal.

**You Will:**
-------------

* Own well-scoped features and components inside multi-quarter projects that scale Roblox and make our systems more efficient, from design through production rollout.
* Build and improve systems that use AI and ML to scale services and workloads across multiple geographic regions.
* Find and fix performance and efficiency problems in production services, such as right-sizing workloads and tuning resource usage, using metrics and profiling data.
* Work with product and infrastructure teams to understand their problems and help solve them with software.
* Take part in on-call and incident follow-ups, and turn what you learn into lasting reliability improvements.

**You Have:**
-------------

* Experience: a BS degree (or equivalent professional experience) in Computer Science or a related engineering field, with at least 2 years of experience building backend systems or AI/ML pipelines (internships and research count).
* Coding skill: strong proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Rust, Go, Java, C#), and you write clean, tested, maintainable code.
* Systems fundamentals: a solid grasp of distributed systems concepts (concurrency, networking, caching, load balancing, failure modes), and an interest in going deeper.
* Interest in performance: you have profiled, benchmarked, or tuned a service or pipeline and can explain what you changed and why it helped.
* Curiosity: you want to know how things work under the hood, and you keep going on hard problems until you understand them.
* **Nice to have**: experience with containers and orchestration (Kubernetes, Nomad), observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana), or applying ML/forecasting to operational data.

**You Are:**
------------

* A Learner: you take in feedback quickly, look for mentorship, and grow your scope over time.
* A Partner: you know the best tools fit into the existing tooling ecosystem. You approach partners with curiosity and work to understand a problem before you start coding.
* A Problem Solver: you ask good questions, form hypotheses, and use data to test them.
* Dependable: you break your work into milestones, estimate honestly, and keep your team updated on progress and blockers.
* A Team Player: you contribute to code reviews, documentation, and shared team goals, and you help make long-running projects succeed.

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.

For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. **WHY WE’RE LOOKING FOR YOU**
